_comment: Maps a canonical Activity name (as it appears in Data/Summary, i.e. the VALUE side of activity_aliases.json) to an automation assessment. tier is one of: 'P0-DataOps' (rule-based / scriptable ETL-style work), 'P1-LLM' (needs judgment but is pattern-based - a good LLM/agent fit), 'Manual-only' (needs human judgment, relationship work, or is inherently bespoke). reducible_pct is a rough estimate of the SHARE of time on that activity that could be eliminated once automated - a starting guess for you to correct, not a measured number. Any activity not listed here shows as 'Unclassified' in the output rather than being guessed at silently.

PII Setup.rationale: One-time config work, largely scriptable per account.

Updated Refresh.rationale: Looks like a repeatable data refresh job.

Reportable Malfunction Formatting Script.rationale: Formatting step in an existing script pipeline.

Tagging QA.rationale: Reviewing tags against rules - LLM-assisted QA.

FMEA Tagging.rationale: Matching complaints to a reference library - LLM-assisted.

PII.rationale: General PII review work - LLM pass plus human confirmation.

PII QA.rationale: Residual-PII review - LLM pass plus human confirmation.

PII QA - Div 55.rationale: Residual-PII review - LLM pass plus human confirmation.

ASG Creation.rationale: Signal detection has real judgment, but drafting/first-pass is LLM-assistable.

ASG Creation - Div 30.rationale: Signal detection has real judgment, but drafting/first-pass is LLM-assistable.

ASG Creation - Div 60.rationale: Signal detection has real judgment, but drafting/first-pass is LLM-assistable.

ASG Creation - SPT.rationale: Signal detection has real judgment, but drafting/first-pass is LLM-assistable.

App QA.rationale: Functional QA mostly needs a human, but test-case drafting is LLM-assistable.

Product QA.rationale: Functional QA mostly needs a human, but test-case drafting is LLM-assistable.

App QA / Product QA.rationale: Legacy combined bucket - see App QA / Product QA individually.

Quarterly Dashboard Documentation.rationale: Documentation drafting is LLM-assistable; structure/review stays manual.

Calls.rationale: Relationship work - not an automation target.

Workspace Config.rationale: Bespoke per-account setup; low repeat volume.

X-ray QA.rationale: Visual/image review; possible future vision-LLM candidate but not assessed.

Reportable Malfunction Processing Script.rationale: Script maintenance/engineering work, not the repetitive task itself.

Quarterly Report Dashboard Creation.rationale: Bespoke each quarter; low repeat volume.
